articles.title: Sands China’s Community Revitalization Programme Unveils ‘The Hall of Glory – Iec Long Firecracker Factory’
articles.rawDate: Nov.17 Sands China’s Community Revitalization Programme Unveils ‘The Hall of Glory – Iec Long Firecracker Factory’
articles.summary: Sands China unveiled The Hall of Glory at the former Iec Long Firecracker Factory, a permanent community-tourism attraction developed with Professors Jeffrey Shaw and Sarah Kenderdine. The exhibition on the original site preserves Macao’s century-old firecracker heritage through historical research, oral history and immersive new-media art.

articles.title: GEG Collaborates with DSAL and Local Organizations to Support the Professional Growth of Local Team Members
articles.summary: Galaxy Entertainment Group became the first integrated tourism and leisure enterprise in Macau to work with DSAL and FAOM on advanced Chinese cuisine chef occupational skill assessment. Since the start of 2026, around 1,500 local team members have completed over 16,000 training hours across food and beverage, facilities management and security.

articles.title: Wynn Hosts 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards Kick-Off Event in Shanghai
articles.summary: On November 9 in Shanghai, Wynn hosted a kick-off event for the 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards, themed “Three Years in the Making, A New Chapter Begins.” Wynn announced the 2027 calendar, with judging week in Beijing from August 21–25 and the annual awards ceremony in Macao on October 29.

articles.title: GEG Donates MOP700,000 to Tung Sin Tong to Support Its Annual Fundraising Campaign for the 23rd Consecutive Year
articles.summary: Galaxy Entertainment Group donated MOP700,000 to Tung Sin Tong’s annual fundraising campaign for the 23rd consecutive year. Since 2004, GEG has given more than MOP11 million to the charity.

articles.title: Sands China Donates Over MOP 400,000 in Funds and Prizes to Support Caritas Macau Bazaar and Charity Run
articles.rawDate: Nov.10 Sands China Donates Over MOP 400,000 in Funds and Prizes to Support Caritas Macau Bazaar and Charity Run
articles.summary: Sands China donated funds and prizes valued at over MOP 400,000 to Caritas Macau for the 2026 Charity Run and the 57th Charity Bazaar, its 23rd consecutive year of support. 150 Sands Cares Ambassadors also volunteered at both events.

articles.title: Sands China Performing Arts Programme Presents: ‘Macau Band Directors Association 30th Anniversary Concert’
articles.rawDate: Nov.10 Sands China Performing Arts Programme Presents: ‘Macau Band Directors Association 30th Anniversary Concert’
articles.summary: Sands China partnered with the Macau Band Directors Association to present the association’s 30th anniversary concert at The Parisian Theatre, coinciding with The Parisian Macao’s 10th anniversary. More than 550 musicians from Macao and France performed for an audience of over 1,500.

articles.title: MGM Supports Tung Sin Tong’s Annual Charity Event for the 19th Consecutive Year
articles.summary: MGM donated MOP700,000 to Tung Sin Tong’s annual fundraising campaign for the 19th consecutive year, bringing cumulative donations to MOP10 million. CEO Kenneth Feng presented the cheque at MGM COTAI alongside Tung Sin Tong chairman José Chui Sai Peng.
